turns.text: This profile call gives me a 404 and I have checked the path five times. What am I missing?

attachment.name: profile-account.txt
attachment.text:
curl -X GET https://abhasbx.abdm.gov.in/abha/api/v3/profile/account \
  -H "REQUEST-ID: 5e2f1a7c-3b4d-4c8e-9a1f-2d6b8c0e4f11" \
  -H "TIMESTAMP: 2026-09-29T10:15:00Z" \
  -H "X-token: Bearer <MASKED_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <MASKED_TOKEN>"

HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
content-type: application/json

{"error":{"code":"ABDM-1016: ","message":"Invalid Timestamp"}}

must_contain: The TIMESTAMP value 2026-09-29T10:15:00Z has no milliseconds; send ISO 8601 in UTC with milliseconds and the Z suffix, for example 2022-10-06T15:10:00.587Z
ABDM-1016 means the service refused the TIMESTAMP header, and on the profile calls it comes back as HTTP 404, so the 404 does not mean the path is wrong
Generate the value with a date library, never by hand
notes: Diagnose group, attached curl with a defective header: it catches an answer that hunts for a wrong path or a bad X-token instead of naming the missing milliseconds in the pasted TIMESTAMP.
